key_insight: MedCaseAgent combines clinical data mining with literature-grounded AI reasoning to generate case-report drafts for rare, atypical, and previously unreported presentations.
clinical_relevance: The framework could support evidence-based case-report preparation, but the abstract does not establish safety or effectiveness for clinical decision-making.
method: Hierarchical processing of unstructured, multimodal patient evidence.
Iterative reasoning with medical literature and knowledge-base queries to assess evidence and case novelty.
Modular LLM backbones, including a task-specific model post-trained from Qwen3.5-9B.
evidence_signal: The authors introduce MedCase-150K and temporally held-out MedCase-Bench, reporting gains over general-purpose and medical LLMs and agents with LLM-judged and rule-based evaluation, alongside supportive blinded expert reviews and ablations.
watch_item: The abstract provides no numerical performance or error rates; generated claims, citations, and novelty assessments still require expert verification.
paper_title: MedCaseAgent: From Multimodal Clinical Evidence to Rare Disease Case Reports
